name: Naturalization
overview: Scripture uses the concept of naturalization to illustrate the spiritual transformation from alienation to belonging in God's family. In Acts 22:28, Paul highlights the distinction between being free born and gaining freedom by purchase, symbolizing the difference between inherent and granted status. Ephesians 2:12 describes believers as once being strangers and aliens, separated from God's promises and hope. However, Ephesians 2:19 assures that through Christ, believers are no longer foreigners but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God's household, emphasizing the new identity and inclusion granted by grace.
